# BLOODHOUND — QA Plan
**For: QA Agent | Generated by: PLAN Agent | Date: 2026-02-28**

> **Notation:** Owner answers are unmarked. PLAN agent decisions are marked **`[PLAN]`**.

---

## 1. Primary User Personas

**Persona 1 — Retail Trader / Memecoin Trader (PRIMARY — MVP optimized for this)**
- Follows KOLs and insiders on Solana
- Wants to know: who bought early, did they sell, who funds who, where is smart money going
- Uses: wallet search, tracked wallets, live feed, Bloodhound AI relationship queries

**Persona 2 — Researcher/Analyst (SECONDARY)**
- Builds intelligence reports, investigates token launches
- Uses: graph view, timeline, side wallet detection, export features

**Persona 3 — Security Researcher (SECONDARY)**
- Investigates rugs, scams, suspicious patterns
- Uses: classification engine, insider detection, known bad actor database

> **Critical MVP standard:** Every flow in Persona 1's journey must be flawless at launch. If a memecoin trader can't quickly find who sniped a token or whether a KOL sold — the launch fails.

## 3. User Stories & Test Cases

Each story has: **Given / When / Then** acceptance criteria and a **FAIL condition**.

---

### EXPLORER STORIES

---

**US-001 — Wallet Search**
> As a trader, I can search any Solana wallet address and see its full profile within 5 seconds.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | A valid Solana wallet address exists and has on-chain history |
| **When** | User pastes or types the address into universal search and hits Enter |
| **Then** | Wallet profile page loads within 5 seconds with: balance, portfolio USD, classification badges, transaction history (≥1 tx visible), first/last active dates |
| **FAIL** | Page load >5s OR blank/error state on valid address OR missing any required sections |

**Edge cases:**
- Address with 0 transactions → shows profile with "No on-chain activity" message, does not error
- Invalid address format → shows "Invalid Solana address" inline error, does not navigate
- Very new wallet (1-2 txs) → loads correctly with partial data
- Extremely active wallet (1M+ txs) → still loads within 5s (pagination handles this)

---

**US-002 — Token Holdings with Live USD Values**
> As a user, I can see all tokens held by a wallet with live USD values.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | A wallet holds 1 or more tokens |
| **When** | User views the wallet profile page |
| **Then** | Token holdings grid shows: token logo, name, amount, USD value (from Birdeye/Jupiter). Values update within 30 seconds of market movement. |
| **FAIL** | USD values show as $0 or "N/A" for tokens with active markets OR values are >5 minutes stale |

**Edge cases:**
- Wallet holds a token with no price data (new/obscure) → show amount without USD, note "No price data"
- Wallet holds 50+ tokens → all shown, sorted by USD value descending. Pagination or virtual scroll handles large lists.
- SOL balance change while viewing → updates without page refresh (WebSocket)

---

**US-003 — Transaction History Filters**
> As a user, I can filter a wallet's transaction history by type, token, date, and amount.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | A wallet has transaction history |
| **When** | User applies any filter (type, token, amount range, date range, direction, program, success/failed) |
| **Then** | Table updates to show only matching transactions. Applied filters are visually indicated. "Clear filters" resets to all. |
| **FAIL** | Filter applies but returns incorrect results OR filter UI crashes OR clear filters doesn't work |

**Test matrix:** Test each filter type individually, then combined (type + date + amount).

---

**US-004 — Token Page**
> As a user, I can look up any token and see its price chart, top holders, and recent large trades.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | A token mint address or symbol exists |
| **When** | User searches for the token |
| **Then** | Token page loads with: price chart (OHLCV, multiple timeframes), holder list (ranked, known wallets flagged), recent large trades (with source logo), security score, launch info |
| **FAIL** | Price chart doesn't render OR holder list is empty for a token with known holders OR page errors |

**Edge cases:**
- Pump.fun token (not yet graduated) → shows pump.fun-specific data (graduation status, bundlers, insider wallets)
- Token with very low liquidity → shows data with "Low liquidity" warning
- Unknown/new token → shows what data is available, graceful partial state

---

**US-005 — User-Defined Label Search**
> As a user, I can search by a user-defined label ("poop") and it resolves to the correct wallet I assigned it to, or that exists in the known wallets database.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | User has a tracked wallet labeled "poop" OR a known wallet in the DB has that label |
| **When** | User types "poop" into the universal search |
| **Then** | Autocomplete shows "poop" under "Your Tracked Wallets" section, resolving to the correct address. Clicking navigates to that wallet's profile. |
| **FAIL** | Label doesn't appear in autocomplete OR resolves to wrong wallet OR requires full address instead of label |

**Edge cases:**
- Label exists in both user's tracked list AND known wallets DB → user's tracked wallet takes priority
- Label search returns no match → "No wallets found for 'poop'" — suggests searching by address
- @twitterhandle search → resolves to linked wallet if Twitter API has the association

### BLOODHOUND AI STORIES

---

**US-010 — Relationship Query (CRITICAL — must be perfect at launch)**
> As a user, I can type "does [label] send to [label]" and get a confirmed/denied answer with tx evidence.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | User has tracked wallets labeled "poop" and "punk" (or uses known wallet labels) |
| **When** | User types "does poop send to punk" into Bloodhound AI |
| **Then** | Response within 8 seconds includes: YES/NO answer, total SOL amount, transaction count, date of last interaction, list of tx signatures with amounts (clickable), CONFIRMED/PROBABLE/SUSPECTED confidence badge |
| **FAIL** | Response takes >8s OR answer is incorrect (says NO when txs exist or YES when they don't) OR tx signatures are not clickable OR no confidence indicator shown |

**This story's failure = launch failure. Test with 20 known wallet pairs, verify 100% accuracy.**

**Test cases:**
- Direct transfer: poop → punk (CONFIRMED expected)
- No direct transfer: poop ↛ punk (no indirect path) → "No direct transfers found. [UNKNOWN]"
- Indirect path: poop → walletX → punk → "No direct transfers found. Indirect path exists: poop → [wallet] → punk. [PROBABLE]"
- Unknown label: user types "does xyz send to punk" where xyz is not in tracked list → "Label 'xyz' not found. Did you mean one of your tracked wallets? [list them]"

---

> As a user, I can ask "who funded this wallet" and get the origin chain traced.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | User asks about a wallet (by address or label) |
| **When** | User types "who funded [wallet]" |
| **Then** | Response shows: originating wallet (with label if known), SOL amount, date, full hop trace if indirect (e.g., "Exchange → walletA → this wallet") |
| **FAIL** | Returns "no data" for wallets with clear funding history OR hop trace is truncated without explanation |

### TRACKED WALLETS STORIES

---

**US-014 — Save Wallet with Label**
> As a user, I can save any wallet with a custom label and it persists across sessions.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | User is logged in |
| **When** | User clicks "Track This Wallet" on any wallet profile and enters a label |
| **Then** | Wallet appears in their Tracked Wallets dashboard with the custom label. After logging out and back in, wallet and label persist. |
| **FAIL** | Label lost after session OR wallet not accessible in tracked dashboard OR duplicate wallets can be added |

---

**US-015 — Wallet Groups**
> As a user, I can organize tracked wallets into named groups.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | User has tracked wallets |
| **When** | User creates a group ("insiders") and moves wallets into it |
| **Then** | Wallets appear under that group in the dashboard. Group name is editable. Wallets can be in one group at a time. |
| **FAIL** | Groups don't persist OR wallets appear in wrong group OR free user can create more than 1 group |

**Free tier enforcement:** Free users get exactly 1 group and 50 wallets max. On adding the 51st wallet: show upgrade prompt, do not silently fail.

|---|---|

| **FAIL** | Alert not delivered within 30 seconds OR delivered for non-matching transactions OR missing tx link in notification |

**Test all alert types:** any_tx, sends_to, token_trade, balance_threshold, inter_tracked.

## 4. Agentic AI Test Cases

These test Bloodhound AI's ability to take actions.

**AI-001 — Save Wallet via AI**
- Input: "Save this wallet and call it 'insider1'" (while viewing a wallet profile)
- Expected: Bloodhound AI adds the wallet to tracked list with label "insider1", confirms "Done — insider1 saved to your tracked wallets."
- FAIL: AI says it can't do that OR saves incorrectly OR no confirmation

**AI-002 — Set Alert via AI**
- Input: "Alert me when poop makes any transaction"
- Expected: Alert rule created for poop's address with type "any_tx", default delivery channels. Confirmed in response.
- FAIL: Alert not created OR set for wrong wallet

**AI-003 — Open Graph via AI**
- Input: "Show me the graph for punk"
- Expected: Navigation to graph view with punk as seed wallet
- FAIL: No navigation occurs OR wrong seed wallet

**AI-004 — Follow-up Reference**
- Step 1: "Does poop send to punk?" → answer returned
- Step 2: "What about in the last 30 days?" → AI correctly refines the same query with date filter
- FAIL: AI treats step 2 as a new unrelated query

## 5. Classification Accuracy Tests

Test these 10 wallet archetypes. Verify classifications match known ground truth.

| Wallet type | Expected primary label | Secondary labels |
|---|---|---|
| Binance hot wallet | EXCHANGE | — |
| Known KOL (in DB) | KNOWN KOL | SMART MONEY (if applicable) |
| Pump.fun bundler | BUNDLER | BOT |
| Active DEX arbitrage bot | BOT | — |
| Dev wallet (multiple deploys) | DEPLOYER | — |
| Raydium LP provider | LP PROVIDER | — |
| First 20 buys on a new token | SNIPER | — |
| Wallet holding 1.2% of BONK | WHALE HOLDER (on BONK page) | — |
| Wallet with $60k portfolio | WHALE WALLET | — |
| High-frequency wash trader | WASH TRADER | BOT |

## 6. Error & Edge Case Tests

| Scenario | Expected behavior |
|---|---|
| Search invalid Solana address | Inline "Invalid address" error, no navigation |
| Wallet with 0 transactions | Profile loads, "No on-chain activity recorded" message |
| Bloodhound AI query with no data | "No on-chain evidence found. [UNKNOWN]" — no hallucination |
| AI query about price prediction | "I can't predict price movements. I can show you historical on-chain activity." |
| Free user tries to add 51st tracked wallet | Clear upgrade prompt, wallet NOT added silently |
| Free user tries to create 2nd group | Clear upgrade prompt |
| Anonymous user tries to set alert | Redirect to sign-in / prompt to create account |
| Graph with 400+ nodes | Clustering kicks in, minor nodes grouped into "N unknown wallets" bubble |
| API rate limit hit | 429 response with `Retry-After` header, friendly message |
| Helius API down | Graceful degradation — show cached data, status bar shows "Indexer: degraded" |
| Birdeye API down | USD values show "Price unavailable", rest of page intact |

---

## 7. Security Test Cases

| Test | Expectation |
|---|---|
| Access `/admin` without admin role | 403 Forbidden |
| Non-admin cannot approve wallet submissions | API returns 403 |
| Free user bypasses tracked wallet limit via API | 403 or 429 with clear message |
| Anonymous user calls `/me/tracked` (auth required) | 401 Unauthorized |
| SQL/NoSQL injection in search field | Sanitized, no query injection |
| XSS in wallet label or note field | Escaped on render, no script execution |
| API key of another user used | 401 Unauthorized |
| Overly large payload to `/ai/query` | 413 or 400 with clear message |

---

## 8. Launch Checklist (MVP Acceptance)

All items must be GREEN before v1 launch.

**Core flows:**
- [ ] Wallet search → profile page < 5 seconds for 20 test addresses
- [ ] Transaction history loads and filters work correctly
- [ ] Token page loads with price chart for top 10 tokens by volume
- [ ] Known wallet labels appear globally in search and profiles
- [ ] US-010 (relationship query) tested with 20 wallet pairs — 100% accuracy
- [ ] Bloodhound AI label memory working (no address paste required)

**Tracked wallets:**
- [ ] Save wallet + label → persists after logout/login
- [ ] Free tier limits enforced (1 group, 50 wallets, 5 alerts, 10 AI/day)
- [ ] Alert fires within 5 seconds of triggering tx (test with in-app and email)
- [ ] Live feed updates in real-time without page refresh

**Graph:**
- [ ] 2-hop graph renders within 2 seconds for standard wallets
- [ ] Node click → sidebar opens with correct wallet
- [ ] Export PNG and CSV produce valid files

**Signals:**
- [ ] Feed visible to anonymous users
- [ ] At least 3 signal types generating real events
- [ ] Signal links resolve to correct wallet/tx pages

**Auth:**
- [ ] Sign in with email works
- [ ] Sign in with Google works
- [ ] Sign in with X/Twitter works
- [ ] Anonymous → protected feature → prompted to sign in

**Performance:**
- [ ] Lighthouse score ≥ 80 on wallet profile page
- [ ] No console errors in production build
- [ ] Status bar shows accurate network/indexer state

**Credibility (pre-launch):**
- [ ] Landing page live at bloodhound.xyz
- [ ] GitHub org live with README and repo structure
- [ ] Twitter/X profile live with bio, logo, and pinned tweet
- [ ] Docs skeleton live (even if minimal)
- [ ] Status page live (status.bloodhound.xyz)
